_about: The 0.5.1 film: python3 tools/film.py tools/film-0.5.1.json work/film/film-0.5.1.mp4. Packages are the Hub's (curl -o work/film/pkgs/NAME.fwsc https://thefirmwarehub.com/fw/NAME.fwsc). The 'after' scenes run target/release/fm1-live built from master. The 'before' scenes run the real release binaries where they can render frames: 0.5.0's fm1-live (gh release download v0.5.0 -p 'fm1-emu-0.5.0-macos-arm64.tar.gz', unpacked in work/film/v050/). 0.4.0's fm1-live has no FM1_BENCH_FRAMES, so FRASIL's 'before' runs master as of 0.5.0 with d2bcc33 reverted (work/film/nopll/fm1-live): it plays FRASIL 3.3 with no audio at all, as 0.4.0 does (0.4.0's FM1_BENCH_WAV: 0 bytes).
